review_scope: Merged non-empirical B3 persistent P-33 graph-convergence monitor profile.

Q01.evidence: Scope is explicit: one persistent PDMALConvergenceMonitor per graph sequence, exact reset semantics, registered status ladder, and no empirical efficacy endpoint.

Q02.evidence: Profile, source component, harness, tests, validator, workflow, and merged implementation identity are exact-bound.

Q03.evidence: Provenance binds workload architecture, merged B3 implementation, and exact source/harness/test/validator/workflow blobs.

Q04.evidence: Required interfaces and state are explicit: W_t, W_t-1, divergence counters, event history, graph sequence identity, and normalized edge-state validation.

Q05.evidence: Terminology and role boundaries are explicit; P-33 monitor status is not mapped to consensus alpha and is not presented as an efficacy signal.

Q06.evidence: Implementation conforms to the workload-specific B3 architecture with persistent weighted-graph monitor semantics.

Q07.evidence: Limitations are explicit: fixed registered graph sequence, non-empirical fixtures, no integrated Track C inference, and no Epoch 004 outcome reuse.

Q08.evidence: The registered sequence is deterministic and reproducibly exercises stable, watch, warn, alert, recovery, and converged states.

Q09.evidence: Fixtures contain synthetic graph weights and monitor state only; no personal data or unnecessary empirical records are required.

Q10.evidence: Claim ceiling is explicit: P-33 monitor fidelity and alert behavior only; scientific N remains zero and DGAF efficacy inference is prohibited.

Q11.evidence: Ready only for a later non-empirical integration/adjudication gate. Not ready for empirical execution, integrated Track C claims, High-Assurance acceptance, or production use.

scoring_summary.attestation_note: S-TIER developer self-attestation for the non-empirical B3 profile role only.

limitations: Same developer/operator context performed profile design and qualification; this is not independent verification.
Synthetic graph-sequence fixtures establish source-bound monitor behavior only, not real-workload benefit.
The profile does not establish that P-33 should alter consensus alpha or any other treatment control.
B3 qualification does not establish B1, B2, integrated Track C, or canonical DGAF efficacy.
